preserved_v1.correction: The noncomparable exponent at gap D^(29/96) is 233/288. V2 corrects it and adds the dyadic localization.

method: Count numerator ideals by integer norms at fixed denominator. For noncomparable and short comparable boxes insert exact additive step masks before the two-lcm projector. Freeze the radial profile at ratio one and separate the derivative variation, retaining all phases.
new_bounds: Mixed equal/near signed cross reaches 3/4 at gap D^(1/8) for all d, including d=1, by absolute Cauchy. Slack gap D^(7/60) gives 179/240 with feasible mixed neighborhood. At gap D^(73/216) the noncomparable part, comparable P<=D^(11/30), and variation for higher P reach the target cross.
failed_range: The wider comparable bound without freezing gives 161/192 at gap D^(29/96). The leading comparable profile in the wider high-length boxes and the far small-d cross are unestimated at target.
